correctness.rationale: Both explicit edge lists are independently matched to the standard graphs and checked triangle-free/four-chromatic by exact finite algorithms. Two independent face predicates enumerate 312 and 424 simplices. Exact deterministic pairings give 155 and 211 pairs, leaving exactly one critical vertex and one critical cell of dimension 2 and 3, respectively. Complete topological sorting of all 1,030 and 1,428 oriented Hasse coverings proves acyclicity. Forman discrete Morse theory then yields \(S^2\) and \(S^3\) over the integers with no unproved attachments; mod-two boundaries independently corroborate Betti numbers. Standalone verifier and recorded output are bundled.

value.rationale: The pair consists of the canonical smallest triangle-free four-chromatic graph and smallest four-regular such graph, respectively. The first higher-independence/dissociation complex, a historically motivated P3-devoid construction, has fully determined and contrasting integral homotopy types despite shared chromatic and triangle-free constraints. This is a natural exact classification of two extremal graph examples, not merely a parameter-free deduction or a known-table recomputation. It provides nontrivial test cases for general Ind2 topology; no unsupported universal relationship is asserted.
